newsitem.title: USA: CNS files patent infringement suit.
newsitem.headline: CNS files patent infringement suit.

text.p: CNS Inc said Tuesday it filed suit in U.S. District Court for Minnesota against Breathe Better Inc, alleging that it has offered for sale a product that infringes on patents for the CNS Breathe Right nasal strip.
"We will continue to take appropriate action against this company and others that make or sell infringing products," Daniel Cohen, chairman and chief executive officer, said in a statement.

CNS manufactures and markets consumer products, including the Breathe Right nasal strip. The Breathe Right strip can be effective in eliminating or reducing snoring, for the temporary relief of nasal congestion, and for the temporary relief of breathing difficulties due to a deviated nasal septum, CNS said.
